**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **§ 8.2 (p0033)** — Automatic renewal is limited to successive **12-month** terms (no multi-year auto-renewal), and we may opt out on just **30 days'** written notice. Vendor must also send a **60-day** renewal reminder, and if it fails to do so our opt-out deadline extends to 30 days after the reminder arrives. That satisfies every element of the preferred position and is comfortably inside the fallback (≤60 days).
- **§ 8.3 (p0034)** — Renewal uplift is capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods — the preferred cap, plus two extras favouring us.

Nothing here fails the fallback, and the reminder mechanic and uplift cap benefit us, so I have submitted this as compliant at the preferred position.
